editorial:
Phil and Claire Foster are a tired married couple stuck in a boring routine. Their weekly date night is the only thing keeping their spark alive. When they steal another couple's reservation at a fancy restaurant, they get pulled into a wild night of mistaken identity, car chases, and dangerous criminals. The movie mixes everyday marriage humor with over-the-top action, and it works because the leads feel like real people in a crazy situation. You will laugh at their awkward attempts to act tough while also rooting for them to make it home safe.

Steve Carell and Tina Fey carry the whole movie with their natural chemistry and sharp timing. The action scenes are fun without being too serious, and the pacing keeps things moving. On the downside, some jokes fall flat and the plot is pretty predictable. Still, it is a great pick for a relaxed movie night with your partner or friends. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Phil and Claire track down the real thieves, a couple named Taste and Whippit, and learn the criminals stole a flash drive full of blackmail photos. The Fosters use the drive to blackmail the corrupt district attorney who hired the hitmen. The bad guys are arrested, and Phil and Claire return home, reenergized and closer than ever. The movie ends with them spicing up their date nights, proving that a little danger can bring a couple back together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light action comedies and married-couple humor.
